lede: Procurement AI training helps intermediate practitioners apply machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI across sourcing workflows. It covers supplier discovery and risk scoring, contract anomaly detection, demand forecasting, and automated spend analysis, with practical work on dashboards, contract audits, and forecasting models; learners also consider data readiness, ethical use, and planning AI adoption.

prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of procurement processes (RFx, contracts, supplier management) and basic data literacy. No coding or programming experience is required. A laptop is recommended for hands-on exercises, though pre-configured AI dashboards and datasets are provided. Review your organization's current spend data and identify one procurement challenge to address with AI before attending.
